cases.translation: Saul was consenting to his death.
cases.explain: The transitive verb одобрял (approved/consented) takes a direct object in the accusative case, which for neuter nouns equals the nominative.

cases.sentence: С того дня началось большое гонение на Иерусалимскую ___, и все, кроме апостолов, рассеялись.
cases.translation: On that day a great persecution arose against the Jerusalem church, and all except the apostles were scattered.
cases.explain: The preposition на (against) with motion takes the accusative case. The verb гонение на takes accusative.

cases.sentence: А Савл преследовал ___. Он ходил из дома в дом, хватал мужчин и женщин и бросал их в темницу.
cases.translation: But Saul ravaged the church. He went from house to house, seizing both men and women and putting them in prison.
cases.explain: The transitive verb преследовал (ravaged/persecuted) takes a direct object in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Филипп пришел в главный город Самарии и возвещал там о ___.
cases.translation: Philip came to the principal city of Samaria and proclaimed Christ there.
cases.explain: The preposition о (about) governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Толпы народа внимательно слушали то, что он говорил, и видели знамения, которые он совершал, потому что из многих одержимых выходили с громким криком нечистые ___.
cases.translation: The crowds paid close attention to what he said and saw signs he performed, because unclean spirits came out with loud cries from many who were possessed.
cases.explain: The nominative case is used for the grammatical subject of the verb выходили (came out).

cases.sentence: Там был один человек по имени Симон, который раньше занимался в этом городе ___, изумляя жителей Самарии.
cases.translation: There was a man named Simon who had been practicing sorcery in the city and astonishing the people of Samaria.
cases.explain: The verb занимался (was engaged in) takes the instrumental case when indicating the activity being conducted.

cases.sentence: Когда жители этого города поверили Филиппу, возвещающему Царство Божие и имя Иисуса ___, то многие приняли крещение.
cases.translation: When the people of that city believed Philip as he proclaimed the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized.
cases.explain: The name 'имя Иисуса Христа' uses the genitive case to show possession of the name.

cases.sentence: Ангел Господа сказал Филиппу, Ступай на юг, на дорогу, что ведет через пустыню из Иерусалима в ___.
cases.translation: An angel of the Lord said to Philip, Go south on the road that goes through the desert from Jerusalem to Gaza.
cases.explain: The preposition в (to) with motion takes the accusative case.

reading.ru: Савл же одобрял это убийство. С того дня началось большое гонение на Иерусалимскую церковь, и все, кроме апостолов, рассеялись по Иудее и Самарии.
reading.question: What happened to the church in Jerusalem after Stephen's death?
options: A great persecution arose and all except the apostles were scattered
reading.correct: A great persecution arose and all except the apostles were scattered
reading.explain: The text states that с того дня началось большое гонение (a great persecution arose) and все, кроме апостолов, рассеялись (all except the apostles were scattered).

reading.ru: Филипп пришел в главный город Самарии и возвещал там о Христе.
reading.question: What did Philip do in the main city of Samaria?
options: He collected money for the apostles
reading.explain: The text says Филипп возвещал там о Христе (Philip proclaimed Christ there).

reading.ru: Там был один человек по имени Симон, который раньше занимался в этом городе колдовством, изумляя жителей Самарии.
reading.question: Who was Simon and what was he known for?
options: A sorcerer who amazed the people of Samaria with his magic
A rich merchant who gave to the poor
reading.correct: A sorcerer who amazed the people of Samaria with his magic
reading.explain: Simon был тот, кто занимался колдовством (practiced sorcery) and был изумляя жителей Самарии (amazed the people of Samaria).

reading.ru: Дух сказал Филиппу, Подойди к этой колеснице и иди рядом.
reading.question: What did the Spirit tell Philip to do?
options: Approach the chariot and walk beside it
reading.correct: Approach the chariot and walk beside it
reading.explain: The Spirit told Philip подойди к этой колеснице и иди рядом (approach this chariot and walk beside it).

reading.ru: Евнух спросил Филиппа, Скажи мне, о ком здесь говорит пророк, о себе или о ком-то другом?
reading.question: What question did the eunuch ask Philip about the passage he was reading?
options: Who is the prophet speaking about, himself or someone else?
reading.correct: Who is the prophet speaking about, himself or someone else?
reading.explain: The eunuch asked о ком здесь говорит пророк (who the prophet is speaking about), о себе или о ком-то другом (himself or someone else).

reading.ru: Смотри, вот вода, сказал Евнух, что мешает мне принять крещение?
reading.question: What did the eunuch see and ask about?
options: He saw a river and asked about drinking
He saw water and asked what prevents him from being baptized
He saw the city and asked where the temple is
He saw a bridge and asked how to cross
reading.correct: He saw water and asked what prevents him from being baptized
reading.explain: The eunuch said смотри, вот вода (Look, here is water) and asked что мешает мне принять крещение (what prevents me from being baptized).
